title: Export Diagram to PostgreSQL
description: As a database designer, I want to export my diagram to a PostgreSQL database so that the designed schema is created in a live database.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a diagram and an active PostgreSQL connection, when the user chooses to export to a chosen schema, then the application generates DDL (CREATE TABLE, keys, relationships) for the diagram
And the generated SQL is displayed to the user
And the user must explicitly confirm before any DDL is executed
And existing database objects are never dropped or altered without explicit user action
